name: Massmore_OLED
description: One driver for all 12 Massmore I2C OLED modules (SKU-0102): SSD1306, SH1106, SH1107 and SSD1309. Adafruit-GFX-compatible drawing API and GFXfont support, Thai text rendering with Sarabun fonts 12-32 px (SIL OFL 1.1), UI widgets, hardware/software scroll, non-blocking page refresh and controller identity verification. No external dependencies, no dynamic allocation.
